description: First-time setup for Tacet: look, VS Code settings, notes folder and extras.
config.document.fontSize: Text size of documents in Write and Read, in pixels.
config.notes.folder: Folder where Save puts new notes. Empty: Save asks for a folder.
config.code.lineNumbers: Show line numbers in Code view. Write and Read never show them.
config.terminal.shortcut: Ctrl+` opens and closes the terminal.
config.spelling.enabled: Underline misspelled words. Tacet never changes your text.
